pages.text: Listen well, you mouse-brained furball, because I will only say this once. I am Yellowfang. Those red berries are $(l)deathberries$(). Never eat them. Never give them to a kit. NEVER.
pages.title: Yellowfang Warns You

pages.text: If a cat does eat them, give them yarrow at once. It makes them sick up the poison. You may have only moments.
pages.title: Yarrow
